newsitem.title: FINLAND: INTERAVANTI TO SELL ITS INTERGLOBIA STAKE.
newsitem.headline: INTERAVANTI TO SELL ITS INTERGLOBIA STAKE.

text.p: Finnish real estate investment company Interavanti Oy said in a statement on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its entire 25.2 percent stake in InterGlobia Oy to Canadian Beninco Holdings.
Interavanti said it had written down the value of its InterGlobia shares by six million markka in the January-April report due for publication on May 28.
Interavanti said Beninco had offered to buy all shares in InterGlobia, which also is a real estate investment company.
It did not give any financial details of the transaction but said the deal was expected to be finalised in June.
"The deal will make it possible to strengthen Interavanti's cash flow by releasing funds for more profitable investments," it said.
